verdict.rationale: Supabase exposes a published Management API OpenAPI spec covering organizations, projects, branches and configuration. It also ships a hosted and local MCP server whose tools span database, migrations, logs, advisors, Edge Functions, branching, storage config and account management, plus a headless CLI. Docs explicitly describe UI/agent symmetry for advisors (Studio, MCP, CLI and Management API) and for cron (SQL or Dashboard). missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement or audit of complete UI-to-API parity, programmatic coverage for dashboard-only flows such as the AI Assistant function deploy and Studio log views, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
